captured_goal_text: Move the camera around by holding down the right mouse button
text: Move the camera by holding down the right mouse button and moving the mouse.

captured_goal_text: Move around the room
text: Move using the WASD keys.

captured_goal_text: Talk to Ammit with double-left click
text: Talk to Ammit by double-clicking her. This selects your default action.

captured_goal_text: Choose wisely
New Recruit Orientation
Click on your display to calibrate
text: The red Health bar shows how much damage you can take before disconnecting temporarily. The yellow Inner Strength bar represents your ability to transcend the rules of the Matrix. The blue Experience bar shows your progress towards a new level of understanding. Calibrate your HUD by clicking on it.

captured_goal_text: Talk to Scarlett
text: Talk to Scarlett by right-clicking on her and selecting Talk. This is the alternate way of interacting with people in the Matrix.

captured_goal_text: Search the wardrobes for a key. Optional, press V to highlight interactive objects.
text: Search the wardrobes by double-clicking them.

captured_goal_text: Take all of the loot
text: Click Take All to take everything.

captured_goal_text: Use the Character menu to check out your Inventory
text: Left click on the flashing Character button and select Inventory from the menu to check your inventory.

captured_goal_text: Drag on your new shoes
text: Drag your new shoes onto your character portrait to equip the shoes.

captured_goal_text: Right-click Scarlett and Give her the key
text: Right-click Scarlett and select Give to give the key.

captured_goal_text: Learn about the combat UI
text: During Close Combat, you face one target at a time. Your camera rotates around the fight.

captured_goal_text: Click on the Character menu and select Actions to open your Action panel
text: Click the flashing Character button and select Actions to open the action panel. This lists your current active Abilities.

captured_goal_text: Learn about the Hotbar
Drag your Cheap Shot onto your hotbar
text: Drag your Cheap Shot ability onto a Hotbar slot.

captured_goal_text: Calibrate your blue Speed tactic
text: Click on the blue Speed tactic. This does moderate damage, high accuracy, and can Daze opponents.

captured_goal_text: Calibrate your red Power tactic
text: Click on the red Power Tactic icon. Power attacks do high damage with low accuracy. Power can Stagger opponents.

captured_goal_text: Calibrate your green Grab tactic
text: Left click on the green Grab Tactic button. Grab inflicts little damage, but can leave you with high defense and your enemies Off Balanced.

captured_goal_text: Calibrate your yellow Block tactic
text: Click the yellow Block icon. Blocking helps you recover from being dazed, staggered, or off-balance. Block is the only tactic that restores Inner Strength, but there's still a chance a skilled opponent can get past your defenses.

captured_goal_text: Select Withdraw with mouse click
text: Click on the red Withdraw icon. Use withdraw to escape a Close Combat fight.

captured_goal_text: Open the doors and enter the dojo.
text: Open the doors by double-left clicking them.

captured_goal_text: Use your new combat skills
text: Fight the guard by double clicking on him. In Close Combat, you always have one tactic active. Examine the effects of using the various tactics, and choose yours carefully. Also, your camera will pivot around the fight instead of around your character.

captured_goal_text: Defeat the Guard. Notice: your camera will pivot around your fight.
text: Drag your Cheap Shot ability onto a Hotbar slot.

captured_goal_text: Loot the corpse
text: Double-click on the guard's body to search it.

captured_goal_text: Practice combat.
Learn about conning and sizing up your enemies
text: The color of an Enemy's name shows the enemy's threat to you. Grey, Green, or Blue are weaker than you. Yellow are equal. Orange, Red, and Purple targets are dangerous.

captured_goal_text: Click on a target, and click on the gun icon in the Free Fire dropdown on the hotbar to fire continuously.
text: Click on a target, and click on the gun icon in the Free Fire dropdown on the hotbar to fire continuously. Once you start firing, you'll keep firing until you or your target is dead. Using an ability may temporarily delay your next shot.

captured_goal_text: Double click on the Hardline to Upload your codes and mission items. All other items must stay in the Matrix.
text: Double-click on the hardline to upload your code and mission items  Uploaded codes go to personal storage. Only codes can be uploaded; items must stay in the Matrix.

captured_goal_text: Review your status panel. Leveling up gives you more Memory Capacity for Abilities and allows you to improve your Attributes.
text: Click the flashing Character button and select Status to see your new statistics.

captured_goal_text: Open up the level up panel. Raise your upgradeable Abilities to maximum level.
text: Some abilities can be upgraded. You must upgrade your abilities if you hope to survive. A level 50 character with a level one ability is like a gun without bullet.

captured_goal_text: Select Awakened
text: Select the Awakened Ability. This program is the kernel of all abilities. As you invest in improving Awakened, you improve your other abilities as well. Always be sure Awakened is raised to its maximum level.

captured_goal_text: Increase Awakened to Level Two. Spend Information to improving your upgradeable Abilities.
text: $Information is what makes the Matrix go. You can invest $Information into your abilities, but only to the limit of your Character's level. If you don't have maxed out Ability Levels, you are underperforming - and risking your survival.

captured_goal_text: Select the Confirm button to confirm your investment in Awakened.
text: Once you invest in an upgrade, your investment is locked in. However, you can add and remove your abilities from hardlines and from the loading area – effectively changing your character class.

captured_goal_text: Open the attribute level up panel. This is where you improve your character's Attributes.
text: Each time you level up, you can spend a point on your attributes. Select an Attribute to upgrade.

captured_goal_text: Increase an attribute to level two
text: Attributes improve your performance with a range of abilities.

captured_goal_text: Confirm your attribute investment
text: Click on the + icon to upgrade your Attribute.

captured_goal_text: Exit the tutorial
text: To end the tutorial, right-click on the hardline in the phone booth and select Jack into the Matrix.
